title: 80,000 Miles of Wire Hold Up This Bridge
text:
Each of the Golden Gate Bridge's two main cables is about 36 inches thick and holds 27,572 steel wires, about 80,000 miles of wire in all, enough to circle the Earth more than three times. The wires were spun in place across the strait before the deck was hung, and so many wires share the load that a few breaks do not matter.

Follow for engineering you can see from the road.

Source: https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Golden_Gate_Bridge
